record.notes: Signed and published on 20 July 2026 and in force from publication (Article 58), unless individual provisions say otherwise. Article 11 designates the Hellenic Data Protection Authority as notified body for high-risk systems put into service by law-enforcement, migration and asylum authorities, Article 13 allows real-world testing of high-risk systems outside sandboxes, and Article 20 adds AI Act infringements to the scope of Law 4990/2022. Article 26 repeals the AI chapter of Law 4961/2022 (Chapter B of Part A); the public-sector AI register and the AI Observatory are re-established at the Special Secretariat for AI and Data Governance, and public bodies already using AI systems must register them by 31 December 2026. Part B holds other provisions of the Ministries of Digital Governance and Interior, among them Article 47 on using an AI system to evaluate and manage state-aid actions of the Partnership Agreement for Regional Development. The Commission's list of single points of contact (last updated 7 September 2026) names the Hellenic Data Protection Authority for Greece without the mark for a designation still pending.

The gazette confirms the title, number, date, signatures and Articles 1-26, 47 and 58; the Commission page confirms the single point of contact. No English translation of the law was found; the DPA release gives an English rendering of the title only. Version 1's consultation dates (legal-news sites) rested on no stored file and were removed.

judgment.status_reasoning: Article 58: the law enters into force on publication in the Government Gazette, unless individual provisions say otherwise; it was published on 20 July 2026, which has passed. Part A has no deferred commencement (Article 25(2) sets a registration deadline, not a commencement). No amendment or repeal appears in the stored files. 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: National law implementing the EU AI Act (authorities, sanctions, sandbox, public-sector register, deepfake-marking offence); in scope with no note.
